title: Fix WGPU Component Hover, Select, and Vertex Visibility
description: Migrate the raw-wgpu OS/playground stack from browser-only wasm-bindgen/web-sys to winit windowing/input (native + web) and trunk build tooling, plus native hot-swappable plugin hosting.
summary: Fixed WGPU component-level 3D interaction beyond mesh hover. Root causes for invisible vertices/faces: selection targets were never synced into World3dState, so vertex/edge target flags from lowpoly were ignored; append_component_overlays only drew highlight markers for already-selected/hovered ids, not base vertex points when vertex target is enabled (React parity). Fixes: sync selection targets + activeObjectId from selection JSON; draw base vertex jack markers when targets.vertex; show baseline wireframe when targets.edge; scope hover highlights to matching object+granularity; add translucent face overlays for hover/selection in face mode; remove temporary [DEBUG] instrumentation. Pointer coordinate scaling fix retained. cargo test infinite_world (9) + ui_wgpu (28) pass; renderer wasm rebuilt.
